remarks: Please submit Highest & Best Offers by 2/16 Monday at 2:00pm. Nestled in the beloved Pepper Ridge neighborhood. This isn't just a house, it's the home you've been dreaming about. Every inch has been thoughtfully reimagined with an inviting open floor plan, rich hardwood floors, and a breathtaking kitchen dressed in white quartz and equipped with top-tier Bosch appliances. Including a chef-worthy 6-burner gas range. Beyond the 4 bedrooms and 3 new baths, you'll love the flexible spaces including a newly created, sprawling family room. Complete with a stylish dry bar and wine cooler. Perfect for game day and entertaining. The convenient lower level fourth bedroom doubles as an office or guest in-law retreat. A thoughtful laundry and drop-zone mudroom provides the perfect landing spot and walks out to your private outdoor oasis. The exterior is equally impressive: professional landscaping graces nearly half an acre, complemented by all-new masonry, retaining walls, porch, patio, expanded driveway, fresh fencing and irrigation system. New Hardie board siding and roof complete the package, along with an oversized garage for all your toys. This is a truly move-in ready gem. Just unpack your bags. Welcome to your new home sweet home!
